title: Compatible monogenic presentation after principal localization
statement: Let $R$ be a normal Nagata domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] [def-weil-pbc-nagata-ring] in universe $u$, $K$ its fraction field in universe $v$, $x\in K$, $S=R[x]$, and $a\in R\setminus\{0\}$. There exist a normal Nagata domain $A$ and fraction field $L$, both in universe $\max(u,v)$, $y\in L$, an injective map $c:R\to A$ with $c(a)$ a unit, and an isomorphism $e:S_{a}\simeq A[y]$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away]. For every $r\in R$, $e(r/1)$ is the coefficient image of $c(r)$, and $e(x/1)=y$.

proof.text: Let B=R_a. Domain and normality follow from the explicit Mathlib lemmas IsLocalization.Away.isDomain and isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization; Tag 032U supplies Nagata. Embed B in K by mapToFractionRing and apply isFractionRing_of_isLocalization.

Set A=ULift B in universe max(u,v). Transport normality and the fraction-field property through ULift.ringEquiv. The bijective map B -> A is finite; finite Nagata ascent makes A Nagata. Set L=Frac(A) and use IsLocalization.algEquiv to identify K with L over A.

Restrict the field equivalence to g:S -> A[y]. Since g(a) is a unit, extend g to e0:S_a -> A[y]. IsLocalization.lift_injective_iff and the two injective embeddings show e0 injective. Map B to S_a by coefficient localization and then A to S_a by ULift.down. Localization ringHom_ext on R proves that its composite with e0 is the coefficient inclusion. The generator y is also in the range. Algebra.adjoin_induction proves surjectivity, so bundle e0 as a ring equivalence. The lift equations prove both compatibility identities.

lean.statement: theorem exists_monogenic_principal_localization_model (R : Type u) (K : Type v) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R] [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K] (hR : IsNagataRing R) (x : K) (a : R) (ha : a ≠ 0) : ∃ (A L : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing A) (_ : IsDomain A) (_ : IsIntegrallyClosed A) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra A L) (_ : IsFractionRing A L), IsNagataRing A ∧ ∃ (y : L) (c : R →+* A), Function.Injective c ∧ IsUnit (c a) ∧ ∃ e : Localization.Away (algebraMap R (Algebra.adjoin R ({x} : Set K)) a) ≃+* Algebra.adjoin A ({y} : Set L), (∀ r : R, e (algebraMap _ _ (algebraMap R (Algebra.adjoin R ({x} : Set K)) r)) = algebraMap A _ (c r)) ∧ e (algebraMap _ _ (⟨x, Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_singleton x)⟩ : Algebra.adjoin R ({x} : Set K))) = (⟨y, Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_singleton y)⟩ : Algebra.adjoin A ({y} : Set L))
